facts.text: Lake Superior State University offers the first degree program in the United States focusing on the quantitative analysis of cannabis related compounds and contaminants including THC, CBD, and terpenes.

sources.title: Cannabis Chemistry – School of Chemistry, Environmental, and Geosciences
sources.quote: LSSU's Cannabis Chemistry is the first degree program in the United States focusing on the quantitative analysis of cannabis related compounds and contaminants including THC, CBD, terpenes, etc.
